color.note: Dark is the primary theme. Neutrals carry the UI; colour lives in icons, one indigo accent and faint glows.

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Page background. Glows sit on top of this.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, sidebars: one step up from bg-base.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, inputs, icon tiles, menus.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body. 16.8:1 or better on every background.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, descriptions, inactive nav. 7.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Meta text, timestamps, placeholders. 4.7:1 or better on every background.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected state, focus ring. Used sparingly: one primary action per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent-coloured text. 5.8:1 or better.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fill (4.7:1).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Default 1px divider and the mid-stop of every gradient border. Decorative: below 3:1 by design, never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-faint
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of gradient borders, where the edge fades out.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, hovered card edges.

tokens.name: edge-highlight
tokens.usage: Top stop of gradient borders: the thin light catching the upper edge.

tokens.name: edge-accent-a
tokens.usage: Indigo end of the accent gradient border (featured cards only).

tokens.name: edge-accent-b
tokens.usage: Orange end of the accent gradient border.

tokens.name: tint-top
tokens.usage: Top of a card's inner background gradient; fades to nothing by 60%.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: Radial glow behind hero sections, bleeding in from the top edge.

tokens.name: glow-warm
tokens.usage: Second, smaller off-centre glow. Never more than two glows per section.

tokens.name: icon-blue
tokens.usage: Inbox, notifications. Icon strokes only; 3.4:1 on white, 5.8:1 on bg-base.

tokens.name: icon-violet
tokens.usage: Issues. Icon strokes only.

tokens.name: icon-amber
tokens.usage: Cycles, in-progress. Icon strokes only.

tokens.name: icon-green
tokens.usage: Projects, done. Icon strokes only.

tokens.name: icon-teal
tokens.usage: Roadmap, timelines. Icon strokes only.

tokens.name: icon-pink
tokens.usage: Insights, analytics. Icon strokes only.

tokens.name: icon-orange
tokens.usage: Triage, attention. Icon strokes only.

tokens.name: icon-red
tokens.usage: Integrations; also the urgent status. Icon strokes only.

tokens.name: icon-indigo
tokens.usage: Teams, people. Same hue as accent.

tokens.name: icon-grey
tokens.usage: Docs, neutral objects.

tokens.name: soft-blue
tokens.usage: Icon-tile fill behind an icon-blue icon.

tokens.name: soft-violet
tokens.usage: Icon-tile fill behind an icon-violet icon.

tokens.name: soft-amber
tokens.usage: Icon-tile fill behind an icon-amber icon.

tokens.name: soft-green
tokens.usage: Icon-tile fill behind an icon-green icon.

tokens.name: soft-teal
tokens.usage: Icon-tile fill behind an icon-teal icon.

tokens.name: soft-pink
tokens.usage: Icon-tile fill behind an icon-pink icon.

tokens.name: soft-orange
tokens.usage: Icon-tile fill behind an icon-orange icon.

tokens.name: soft-red
tokens.usage: Icon-tile fill behind an icon-red icon.

tokens.name: soft-indigo
tokens.usage: Icon-tile fill behind an icon-indigo icon; selected-row wash.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the hero headline, text-primary.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Hero subcopy and lead paragraphs, text-secondary.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Issues move through triage, then into the backlog.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, badges, nav items, table headers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons and nav; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on small screens.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero frames and large feature cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges and status chips.

tokens.name: shadow-inset-top
tokens.usage: Inner top highlight on raised surfaces in dark; pairs with the gradient border.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating cards, menus and popovers. Never on cards that sit in a grid.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Primary button: highlight on top, crisp drop below.
